canonical_project: Telangana Data Centre City (Aloor village, Chevella mandal, ~1,500 acres)
notes: India's first dedicated data centre city proposed on ~1,500 acres at Aloor village, Chevella mandal (Ranga Reddy district); DPR being prepared per CM direction (Jun 2026). Chevella mandal is within Rangareddy district. Policy-stage project: no named investors/sites yet.
